reading: A rare beetle, a type of insect, was found in Pembrokeshire, Wales, after 60 years.
It is called the Short-Necked Oil Beetle.
Last year, people found only dead adult beetles at a place called Castlemartin.
This year, experts found very young beetles there after three years of searching.
Anne Hobbs said the beetles may be having young in Wales again.
These beetles need certain bees to survive.
They also need many flowers and plants to hide in.
They can live in grassy places near the sea.
They move around most on warm, sunny days.
Castlemartin is the only place in Wales where people can find these beetles now.

vocabulary.definition: Saw or discovered something after looking for it.
